name: @chade/ui
description: Web interface of chade, bundled into the chade package and never published on its own

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --minify --outfile=dist/app.js && cp src/styles.css dist/app.css && cp public/index.html dist/
